steps: The saved strict v5 state table exposes idle/attack clip slots. Named clip choices and Reset remain local; selecting and cancelling never changes parameter rows, source draft or any author file.

Chinese/English/Japanese at390px preserve selection identity, focus and values while fitting controls. Explicit helper Apply changes only the selected binding parameter table; cancelling that edited table still preserves all saved author bytes.

The existing full-source Check/Apply stage creates an unsaved draft; ordinary Save writes only the current behavior manifest. Script bytes, other bindings, clips, scene, metadata and identities remain exact.

The GUI-saved mapping is planned, built and run by real Godot: actual initial idle → event3 with shared enabled → attack → one non-looping clip completion → idle. Strict p10 entries retain their event/completion links; runtime execution leaves saved author files unchanged.

limitations: Actual Chrome with local HTTP editor and a trusted Godot binary. No installed Tauri window, native picker, Android or other desktop OS claim.

A disposable fixture prepares scenes, two named clips, a saved strict v5 controller and its publisher. GUI coverage starts at state-to-clip selection; upstream scene, clip and script creation are not tested here.

The UI writes only current binding parameters after explicit application, then ordinary review/draft/Save. Actual Godot entries/completion are independent runtime evidence; this is not a native visual gameplay or packaged-app test.
